findings.observed_source: The function awaits response.json() and, after a non-JSON rejection, awaits response.text() on the same consumed Response body. The second read throws, so it emits a generic HTTP status instead of the plain-text detail promised by its contract.
findings.bounded_fix: Read response text once; parse that captured text as JSON when valid; classify the same captured text on a plain-text response. Preserve the existing structured JSON error parser and status classification.
findings.forcing_guard: Use real Response instances with two distinct plain-text non-2xx bodies and a structured JSON non-2xx body; assert distinct detail/userMessage values and status. findings.observed_source: Both non-2xx paths concatenated arbitrary server response text into thrown errors; upload also logged it. A server body could echo a request value.
findings.bounded_fix: After each existing one-time 401 refresh, use the published shared bareStatusSentence(status) with the HTTP status for both upload and download.
